policy: 2026.09.30.5 is the reviewed learner UI reference for the focused mobile/product polish: the Home workbench is prioritised on phones, Materials filters are thumb-friendly and WebKit-safe, long engineering/evidence metadata wraps on narrow screens, and More is reduced to secondary/reference/progress utilities while Practice owns troubleshooting, process-data and lab/simulator entry points. The pixel tolerance remains locked at maxDiffPixels 12; this approval updates the reference bytes rather than relaxing drift tolerance. Physical-device, real-AT and other human/external evidence remain separate historical/freshness gates and are not relabelled by this visual lock.
